narration: You set up auto-invest, sat back, and watched that number go up. That feels smart. But here's what's quietly happening inside your account.
visual: Dark background. Phone screen mockup showing portfolio balance animating up to $193,241 with a mini bar chart. Text overlay: 'YOU SET IT AND FORGOT IT'. Warning glow appears at bottom of phone.

narration: Number one — when stocks grow faster than bonds, your whole allocation drifts. That 60-40 split you set up? It's probably 76-24 now. Way more risk than you signed up for.
visual: Light background. Two stacked vertical bars side by side: 'THEN' showing 60% blue stocks + 40% gray bonds, 'NOW' showing 76% blue + 24% gray. Arrow between them. Labels animate in.

narration: Number two — when markets crash, that drift bites hard. A drifted portfolio drops 24% while a balanced one only drops 18%. And it takes years to claw that back.
visual: Dark background. Two animated bars dropping during a crash — green 'BALANCED' bar falls less, red 'DRIFTED' bar falls more. Labels -18% and -24% appear with spring animation.

narration: Number three — here's the crazy part. Rebalancing automatically forces you to sell high and buy low. It's the whole investing game, happening in one click.
visual: Light background. Two cards spring in: green 'SELL HIGH' card with stock chart SVG and upward arrow, blue 'BUY LOW' card with bond SVG and downward arrow. Stat appears: '+0.35% every year'.

narration: Vanguard ran the numbers. On a $200,000 portfolio, that 0.35% annual boost from rebalancing compounds into $46,000 extra over 30 years. Wild, right? For 15 minutes of work.
visual: Dark background. Piggy bank SVG in center. Animated counter below ticking up from $0 to $46,000 in green. Total shown as $246,000. Text: 'ONCE A YEAR' pulses in.

narration: The fix takes 15 minutes once a year. Log in, click rebalance, done. Set a reminder for January 1st — go reclaim your $46,000.
visual: Light background. Calendar SVG with January 1st circled in blue. Phone mockup with 'REBALANCE' button. CTA text springs in: 'SET A REMINDER. CLICK REBALANCE. CLAIM YOUR $46K.'
